assets.prompt: Recreate as an ORIGINAL Amazon listing product photo on pure white seamless background. No dropper bottle, no serum bottle, no water cup, no people, no extra props, no watermark.

Recreate as an ORIGINAL beauty product commercial still, 16:9. A stylish woman holds an open classic red lipstick near her face in a bright modern studio with concrete walls and strong directional light. She wears a sleek black sleeveless top. Keep the advertisement-film mood (not a white-bottle product shot). No competitor logos, no watermark, no on-screen UI.

A woman seen from behind walks in a bright studio: yellow-and-white check short-sleeve top, light denim shorts, bright blue shoulder bag with chain strap, blonde bun. Fashion film energy, not a printed water bottle. No competitor logos, no watermark.
